chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 candidate_13 is feasible and currently lowest-cost; S2 no unresolved candidates remain because candidate_04 and candidate_05 were optimized and all other candidates are screened by lower activity plus higher metal price relative to candidate_13; S3 highest-activity candidate candidate_04 differs from the winner and BACKWARD plus TEST_REACHABILITY were executed, giving an unreachable parity requirement. Remaining affordable actions have low decision value; exact validity and Monte Carlo checks are not affordable with the remaining budget.

unresolved_decision_risk.model_validity: candidate_13 optimum uses Tsep_C=30.0, a window edge; exact window-edge validity check was desirable but costs 28 CU and is unaffordable. candidate_04 and candidate_05 have very small bed volumes, but vessel-floor validity check is also unaffordable.
unresolved_decision_risk.descriptor_uncertainty: uncertainty metadata was read for the optimized/high-activity candidates, but RUN_MC(100) for three metals costs about 49.1 CU and is unaffordable. Thus probabilistic robustness was not quantified.
unresolved_decision_risk.screening_rule: screening of 12 candidates used the declared lower-activity-and-higher-price rule rather than exact state-level dominance; exact dominance checks are unaffordable. Under the task stopping rule this is sufficient for S2.
unresolved_decision_risk.decision_confidence: high under the frozen deterministic model and declared screening rule; residual risk comes mainly from uncomputed validity/uncertainty checks rather than from unresolved deterministic candidates.
